apps/api/.purpose: Vitest suite in the Workers runtime (@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers) covering routes, repo, and services

apps/api/migrations/.command: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply taakhelden-db --local
apps/api/migrations/.purpose: dry-run new D1 migrations locally before they reach CI

apps/android/.purpose: JUnit suite for the ported core logic plus the app module's build and translation lint; :core alone runs without an Android SDK

apps/web/.purpose: no Vitest/Playwright suite exists yet for the Next.js dashboard; typecheck is the current gate

packages/shared/.purpose: Zod schemas are exercised indirectly by apps/api's test suite; typecheck catches contract drift
